commands=[('sdk',['cargo','test','-p','deadlib-lua','--no-default-features','--features','lua51,vendored,send','--test','program','--no-run']+release,['program']),('game',['cargo','test','-p','deadsync-song-lua','--test','actor_input','--test','compiled_input','--test','actor_methods','--test','actor_input_render','--no-run']+release,['actor_input','compiled_input','actor_methods','actor_input_render'])]
paths=list((root/'crates/deadlib-lua/src').rglob('*.rs'))+list((root/'crates/deadsync-song-lua/src').rglob('*.rs'))+[p]+[root/'crates/deadsync-song-lua/tests'/f'{name}.rs' for name in commands[1][2]]
sources={p.relative_to(root).as_posix():hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths}

    assert all(hashlib.sha256((root/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest for n,digest in sources.items())
